quests.name: Slime Trouble
quests.brief: Slimes have crept into what's left of Sela's stores. Thin the forest's supply of them.
quests.accepted: Three fewer slimes in the world and there's coin in it for you.
quests.completed: The stores thank you. So does my nose. Here - you've earned it.

quests.name: Smugglers' Rum
quests.brief: Sela has heard of a cask of rum in Saltmere's sea cave.
quests.accepted: Rook in Saltmere swears the smugglers left a cask of their rum in the sea cave. If it's real, I want it behind my bar.
quests.completed: Real, and terrible, and the regulars will love it. Your drinks are on the house. Well - the first one.

quests.name: The Cheese Run
quests.brief: Bram wants a cheese wheel. Of course he does.
quests.accepted: One wheel. Uncut. I'll know if you nibbled.
quests.completed: Magnificent. Roll on, friend. Roll on.

quests.name: Wolf Watch
quests.brief: Ana's ankles have opinions about the road wolves.
quests.accepted: Two of the big ones, gone. Then I'll walk where I please.
quests.completed: I walked the whole road today and nothing bit me. Take this.

quests.name: The Letter to Saltmere
quests.brief: Deliver Maren's letter to Old Wenna in Saltmere.
answer: Fifty years late, and you've got mud on it. Give it here.
(She reads it twice.) Tam's things never came home, courier. The boat went down off the headland. Whatever the sea kept of him washed into the cave under it.
He sent me this from the foot of the mountain. (A postcard.) "Morvax wants the kings' gold to make Pixelheim a city. Maren says over her dead body. I've brought cheese. Nobody fights over cheese."
quests.postscript: Old Wenna sends Brin's best rope home with you: "Your river bridge burned, I hear. Mend it. Tam would have. Badly, but he would have."
letter: Wenna. Tam didn't die in a rockfall. I said that because the truth was harder to write. The hall came down and he held up the roof so I could run. He was laughing. Of course he was.
I sent his things home on a fishing boat. I couldn't write the rest. I'm sorry. - Maren
quests.answered: Wenna answered, with Tam's last postcard.
quests.gist: Tam's last postcard: "Morvax wants the kings' gold to make Pixelheim a city. Maren says over her dead body. I've brought cheese."

quests.name: The Letter to Blackiron
quests.brief: Deliver Maren's letter to Old Pell at Blackiron.
answer: "Sorry about the cage." Ha! She sat on my canary's cage, fifty years ago. Flat as a griddle. The bird never forgave her.
Tell her this back. Morvax came down this road. Forty years ago, again ten years ago, and last spring. Thin as a rake, asking for iron. I sold him all we had.
Last spring we had none. Something moved into the deep seam, right on top of the ingot the five of them stamped and forgot. He's alive, courier. Or he was in spring.
letter: To Pell, the boy with the canary. Thank you for taking us down the shafts, and for the lamp.
Sorry about the cage. I sat on it. Your bird was right to be cross. - Maren
quests.answered: Pell answered, with a tale of Morvax and the iron.
quests.gist: Pell's tale: Morvax came down the Blackiron road for iron, three times in fifty years. Last spring there was none. He's alive.

quests.name: The Letter to Greyhold
quests.brief: Take Maren's letter to Captain Hale at Greyhold.
answer: A letter for the captain? He's... not receiving. But a letter's a letter. Go on.
(She reads it twice, and goes quiet.) His order book's still on his table, in his hall inside the keep. Read the last page. Then you'll know why the gate was barred.
Maren says Oskar isn't coming home, and the captain can stand down. He's down in the cellars under his hall, still guarding Oskar's shield. Three floors down. Go and tell him.

reading.name: Captain Hale's order book
lines: (Captain Hale's order book lies open on his table, the ink gone brown. The last page is fifty years old.)
"Day 12. We went up and found Morvax alive at the old forge. He begged us to bar the gate and tell Maren nothing. 'Let her think I'm dead. It's kinder.' I agreed. I was wrong."
reading.again: Captain Hale's order book, open at day 12: "I agreed. I was wrong."
reading.shut: Captain Hale's order book, shut on his table. It isn't yours to read.

letter: Captain. Oskar isn't coming home. He held the roof with Tam and Liane so I could get out.
Give his shield to whoever brings you this, and stand down. Your watch is over. - Maren
quests.answered: Ulla answered, with Captain Hale's order book.
quests.gist: Hale's order book, day 12: Morvax alive at the old forge, the gate barred because he asked. "I agreed. I was wrong."

quests.name: The Letter to the Frostgate
quests.brief: Deliver Maren's letter to Aske on the Frostgate pass.
answer: She told me to keep her door shut till someone came for the lantern. Fifty years. You took your time.
(He unlocks Liane's door.) Her sums are still on her desk. She did them the night before the climb. Read them. She'd want somebody to.
The lantern's further down: the stair in her floor goes into the old ice cave, three floors deep. Something white sleeps on it. Mind the cold it breathes.

reading.name: Liane's sums
lines: (Pages of sums in a small, neat hand, weighed down with a brass star. Under the last of them she wrote it out in words.)
"The seal only buys time. Fifty years, at most."
"A thing chained a hundred years will burn anything. Don't seal him. Free him. The collar answers to our five marks."
reading.again: Liane's sums, in her small neat hand: "Don't seal him. Free him."
reading.shut: Pages of sums under a brass star. Aske keeps this room. Ask him first.

letter: Aske. Liane isn't coming back. She asked you to keep her door until someone came for the lantern.
Someone has. Open it, give them her things, and go and sit in the sun. - Maren
quests.answered: Aske answered, and opened Liane's door to her sums.
quests.gist: Liane's sums: the seal only buys fifty years. "Don't seal him. Free him. The collar answers to our five marks."

quests.name: Relics of the Five
quests.brief: Only what the five climbers left behind will open the mountain's gate.
quests.accepted: The gate's barred, courier. The old wardens sealed it when one of the five came home alone, and only what the five left behind will open it: Tam's ladle in Saltmere, the black iron at Blackiron, Oskar's shield at Greyhold and Liane's lantern on the Frostgate. Bring them home to me.
quests.completed: Tam, the iron, Oskar, Liane. And the fifth is mine: my promise that someone would finish what we started. Take it. The gate is open, courier - climb.

quests.name: The Troll Toll
quests.brief: Something under the Deepwood charges travelers in teeth.
quests.accepted: It squats where the old road bends. Mind your kneecaps.
quests.completed: The road east breathes easier. The village remembers this.

quests.name: A First Brew
quests.brief: Vex wants proof you can work a cauldron before she trusts you with the good stuff.
quests.accepted: One health potion, brewed by your own hand: a forest herb, a marsh reed, my cauldron. Then we talk.
quests.completed: Not bad for a first brew. Here - the good stuff, brewed proper.

quests.name: Sea Glass for the Still
quests.brief: Vex wants Saltmere's sea glass for clearer potions.
quests.accepted: Saltmere's beaches are thick with sea glass, they say. Ground fine, it clears a potion like nothing else. Three pieces, please.
quests.completed: Look how it catches the light. My potions will be the envy of the Reach. Here - the first of the clear ones.

quests.name: A Shield of Reeds
quests.brief: Hilda wants to see you work the forge before she calls you a smith.
quests.accepted: Three marsh reeds, woven tight, at my forge. Make me a buckler and keep it - it's yours.
quests.completed: Tight weave. You'll do. Take this for the reeds.

quests.name: Black Iron for the Forge
quests.brief: Hilda wants Blackiron ore on her anvil.
quests.accepted: Garrick's lot at Blackiron dig the best iron in the Reach. Bring me three lumps of it and I'll show you what a forge is for.
quests.completed: Feel the weight of that. I'll make something worth it - and take these embers, I've no use for fire I didn't light.

quests.name: Reeds for a Healer
quests.brief: Iva patches up what the fen bites, but she's out of reeds to bind with.
quests.accepted: Three marsh reeds, and my tent moves to Pixelheim. The marsh west of the gate grows plenty.
quests.completed: Reeds enough to start with. Find me by the shrine - and come to me before you climb.

quests.name: Herbs for the Shrine
quests.brief: Iva's sick-beds by the shrine need fresh forest herbs.
quests.accepted: Four forest herbs, fresh, from the patches in the Whispering Forest. The shrine's beds are never empty for long.
quests.completed: These will do nicely. One more thing, and I can do more for you than patch you up.

quests.name: The Fen Fever
quests.brief: The Mirefen's ghosts carry a fever into town on the mist.
quests.accepted: The fen's ghosts bring a fever in on the mist. Lay three of them and I can brew against it.
quests.completed: The mist is clean again, and I have brewing to spare. From now on, when I heal you, I top your healing potions up to three.

quests.name: Leather for the Stable
quests.brief: Wren lost her stable to the fire and walks travelers' horses by the gate.
quests.accepted: Two wolf pelts for saddle leather. The wolves den in the fields east of here - mind their teeth.
quests.completed: Leather enough! The post stands by the north road - the square is a whistle away now.

quests.name: Feed for the Post
quests.brief: The post horses are thin, and Wren's coin is thinner.
quests.accepted: Five apples. Odo sells them, the horses love them, and I can't afford either.
quests.completed: Look at them eat! Now, about the road north...

quests.name: The North Road
quests.brief: Orc raiders on the Ash Fields keep spooking Wren's riders.
quests.accepted: Three fewer raiders on the Ash Fields and my riders can go out again. Mind the big ones.
quests.completed: The road is clear. My riders taught you to travel light: from now on you walk a tenth faster above ground.

quests.name: The Lost Lute
quests.brief: A troll in the Deepwood took Loras's lute to pick its teeth with.
quests.accepted: Big, green, smells of moss, wearing my lute as an earring. Bring it back and I'll sing you into legend.
quests.completed: My lute! Slightly chewed. It adds character. Pixelheim gains its first verse tonight.

quests.name: A Verse of Fire
quests.brief: Every ballad needs a dragon. Loras can't afford a dragon.
quests.accepted: Kill me a wyvern and tell me how it went. In detail. Wings, fire, your face at the time.
quests.completed: Wings like sails, fire like - no, don't tell me. I'll find the word.

quests.name: A War-Horn
quests.brief: A marching song needs a horn, and Loras knows just the one.
quests.accepted: A fire imp's horn, hollowed out, sounds like the end of the world. Bring me one.
quests.completed: Hear that? From now on my marching song comes with a horn: +20% crit on your next hunt.

quests.name: The First Deposit
quests.brief: Mirelle will open a bank in Pixelheim - once its vault holds something worth guarding.
quests.accepted: Two gems for the vault's first shelf. Dragons hoard them; so do the deep floors.
quests.completed: A vault with something in it is a bank. Find my ledger by the hall - bring your idle gold.

quests.name: Ink Nobody Can Copy
quests.brief: Mirelle's bank notes need an ink no forger can match.
quests.accepted: Two ember shards, ground fine, make an ink that glows under a candle. No forger can match it.
quests.completed: Perfect. Now the notes are safe. The caravans are another matter.

quests.name: Caravan Guard
quests.brief: Deepwood trolls tax Mirelle's caravans in blood and silver.
quests.accepted: The caravan road runs through the Deepwood and the trolls take their cut. Two trolls fewer and the bank can pay better.
quests.completed: The caravans come through whole. Your savings grow faster now: 3% a day, not 2%.

quests.name: Raiders on the Ash Road
quests.brief: Orcs from the Ash Fields have been stopping the valley carts.
quests.accepted: Three of them, north of town where the grass turns grey. The carts bring my thread.
quests.completed: The carts came through this morning. Every spool. Take this.

quests.name: Father's Badge
quests.brief: Ana's father served at Greyhold.
quests.accepted: My father wore Greyhold's badge till the day the fort fell. They laid the garrison in the crypt under the cellars. If his badge is down there with them, I'd like it home.
quests.completed: That's his. The tower's worn right off it from his thumb. Thank you. He kept this for a rainy day, and it's raining.

quests.name: Cheese from the Deep
quests.brief: The Blackiron miners age a cheese down their shafts.
quests.accepted: The miners at Blackiron age a cheese down the shafts. Black rind, they say, and it hums. I need it. For science.
quests.completed: It does hum! Oh, it's perfect. A wheel of my own for your trouble - a fair trade between cheese people.

quests.name: Imp-ossible
quests.brief: Bram swears imps from the mountain's deep floors stole his best cheese knife.
quests.accepted: Two imps. Little red, horns, laughing. One of them has my knife. I'd know it anywhere.
quests.completed: No knife? Doesn't matter. The principle of the thing. Here - and a wedge of the good stuff, later.

quests.name: Dye for the Looms
quests.brief: Mira's new dye needs grave moss from the Mirefen. She will not go there herself.
quests.accepted: Three clumps of grave moss. It grows where the fen is quietest. Too quiet, if you ask me.
quests.completed: That green! The whole valley will want it. Take an antidote - the fen leaves a taste.

quests.name: Wool from the Pass
quests.brief: Mira wants yeti fur for her loom.
quests.accepted: Yeti fur spins into the warmest thread there is. The Frostgate's full of yetis, I hear. Two pelts' worth?
quests.completed: Smells awful. Spins beautifully. Here - a little something from my stores while I get weaving.

quests.name: Stones That Walk
quests.brief: Old Tomas says the Deepwood's walking stones trample the mushrooms he forages.
quests.accepted: Two of the big grey brutes in the Deepwood. Forty years I foraged there in peace.
quests.completed: Mushrooms for the whole winter! My grandson will be sick of them by spring.

quests.name: The Smugglers' Story
quests.brief: Old Wenna wants to know what the smugglers found of her brother Tam.
quests.accepted: Drive off three of them and the rest will talk. They always do.
quests.completed: They say a thing called the Tidecaller nests in the sea cave under the headland, and keeps what the sea brings in. Tam's things too, maybe.

quests.name: The Tidecaller
quests.brief: Something in the sea cave keeps what the tide brings in - maybe Tam's things too.
quests.accepted: The cave mouth is under the western headland, past the lagoon. Mind the steps - and come back.
quests.completed: That's his ladle. That's Tam's. He stirred soup with it and conducted the whole tavern with it after. Keep it - Maren will know what it means.

quests.name: Crabs on the Jetty
quests.brief: The giant crabs have taken the beach, and the nets with it.
quests.accepted: Four of the big ones. Go for the legs, not the shell.
quests.completed: Ha! The nets are ours again. Saltmere owes you a supper.

quests.name: The Lighthouse Lens
quests.brief: Brin wants the old lighthouse lit again.
quests.accepted: Three pieces of sea glass, clear as you can find. They wash up on the beaches and in the cave.
quests.completed: The lamp's lit. Every boat in the bay saw it last night. Thank you.

quests.name: First Catch
quests.brief: Ola wants to see you fish.
quests.accepted: Two fish - your own, mind. The end of the jetty is the easy spot.
quests.completed: Not bad for a landlubber! Keep the rod. The sea's always got more.

quests.name: The Captain's Due
quests.brief: Rook wants the smugglers' captain gone - and his take.
quests.accepted: North-east beach, sitting on his chests like a hen. He bites.
quests.completed: Ha! Saltmere breathes easier. And so do I. Here's your share - fair's fair.

prompt: The captain's gone? Then his take is lying on that beach, and nobody's counting.
Half for you, half for me - or we hand it back to Saltmere and I go honest. Your call, hero.

options.label: Split it with Rook
options.line: Ha! Fair's fair. Spend it somewhere loud.
options.after: Business is good. Don't ask which business.

options.label: Give it back to Saltmere
options.line: Honest. Me. Brin's buying the drinks, and Ola says you're to have her best pearl.
options.after: Honest work's slower. The beer tastes better, though.

quests.name: Fish for the Cat
quests.brief: Since the fire, the town cat eats nothing but fresh fish, and Pip has none.
quests.accepted: Three fresh fish, please! Saltmere's down the cliffs, south of the marsh - follow the path out of the reeds. Mind the crabs.
quests.completed: She's eating! Look at her go. You can keep the bones.

quests.name: The Lost Crew
quests.brief: Goblins hold the upper shafts, and a crew is trapped behind them.
quests.accepted: Four of the diggers, and the crew can get out. The shaft mouth's at the north end of the valley.
quests.completed: They're out - dusty, hungry, alive. And they say the deep seam is open again, and something is guarding it.

quests.name: The Black Seam
quests.brief: Something guards the seam the Ember Seal's iron came from.
quests.accepted: Three floors down, past the cart hall and the west gallery: the Black Seam. Whatever's down there moved in last spring, and it isn't paying rent.
quests.completed: Black iron, stamped with five marks - the same seam the Ember Seal was poured from. That ingot's theirs as much as ours. Keep it.

quests.name: Ore for Pixelheim
quests.brief: Dagny wants the forge in Pixelheim fed.
quests.accepted: Four lumps of blackiron. The veins glint in the shafts' dead ends.
quests.completed: Good ore, that. Hilda can make you something that'll outlast us both.

quests.name: The Cart Hall
quests.brief: Stone golems have taken the cart hall.
quests.accepted: Two of the walking stones. Hit the joints.
quests.completed: The carts are running! Listen to that racket. Beautiful.

quests.name: The Missing Canary
quests.brief: Old Pell's canary is lost in the shafts - and the air down there is bad. Bring her up quick.
quests.accepted: The west gallery, one floor down, last I heard her. Small cage. Mind your fingers.
quests.completed: There's my girl! Cross as ever. Thank you - the air's safe to breathe as long as she's singing.

timed.start: The canary coughs in the bad air. Get her to Pell in %d seconds.
timed.lapse: The canary stops singing. She squeezes out between the bars and flies back down to the west gallery to catch her breath - fetch her again.

quests.name: The Turncoats
quests.brief: Turncoats hold Greyhold's yard.
quests.accepted: Five of the red cloaks, and the yard's ours again. The gate's round the south side - or climb a breach, if you're nimble.
quests.completed: The yard's quiet. First time in years. Now the keep: its door goes down to the cellars, and something down there won't let anyone near the captain's hall.

quests.name: The Hollow Captain
quests.brief: Something keeps Oskar's shield in the cellars.
quests.accepted: Down the keep's stair, through the crypt, to the captain's hall. That's where Oskar's shield hung. Whatever's there has kept it all this while.
quests.completed: Captain Hale. He swore to keep Oskar's shield till Oskar came home, and he kept it fifty years. Take it to Maren. Hale would want it to go home.

quests.name: Stand Down
quests.brief: Greyhold's dead garrison still keeps watch below.
quests.accepted: Three of the old guard, still at their posts in the cellars. Give them the order they never got.
quests.completed: They're at rest. I heard the bell, though there's been no bell here for forty years.

quests.name: The Chapel Bell
quests.brief: Brother Teo wants old steel to mend the chapel bell.
quests.accepted: Old steel - the garrison's broken blades. It's all over the yard and the cellars, if you look.
quests.completed: That'll ring. Not well, but it'll ring. Hilda in Pixelheim could make you something from the rest.

quests.name: Fenwick's Locket
quests.brief: Fenwick left something in the cells.
quests.accepted: My sister's locket. They took it when they threw me in the cells - the end cell, under the straw.
quests.completed: That's hers. That's... thank you. Here - it's not much. It's all the turncoats didn't find.

prompt: There's something else. Five of my old crew still hide in the low cells. They sold nothing - they only ran. If Ulla finds them, they hang. Will you tell her?

options.label: Keep his secret
options.line: Then they walk home tonight, by the north stair. I won't forget it.
options.after: Word came from the coast: five red cloaks got home. They drink to you, I'm told.

options.label: Tell Ulla
options.line: Ulla's coin for my friends' necks. ...Fine. It's your road, not mine.
options.after: I fetch the water. It's a living. It's what's left of one.

quests.name: Wolves on the Pass
quests.brief: The pass's wolves have gone bold with the cold.
quests.accepted: Four of them, and the caravan can breathe again. They den west of the lake.
quests.completed: Good. Now - you didn't climb up here for wolves. You want Liane's observatory. The way down to the ice cave is through her door, and something has moved in.

quests.name: Liane's Lantern
quests.brief: Something white sleeps on Liane's lantern under the observatory.
quests.accepted: Through her door and down the stair, three floors down to the glass hall. Her lantern's there - the last thing she lit before the climb. Mind the cold it breathes.
quests.completed: Her lantern. She said she'd blow it out herself when they all came home. Take it up the mountain, courier. Let it see the way she went.

quests.name: The Lost Strongbox
quests.brief: Yetis carried off the caravan's strongbox.
quests.accepted: Tracks went up toward the observatory. If there's a den in that cave, my box is in it.
quests.completed: Still locked! The yetis must have given up on it. Here - your share, and then some.

quests.name: The Last Wagon Down
quests.brief: Gunnar's last wagon waits at the cave mouth. Walk it down the pass to his camp - the wolves know a wagon when they smell one.
quests.accepted: Old Bergit pulls it - she's slow, and she stops dead if anything with teeth comes near. Stay close, clear the road, and she'll get there.
quests.completed: Down in one piece! Mostly. The pass's last run of the season, and the first in years that didn't feed the wolves.

quests.name: Frost Lilies for Vex
quests.brief: Vex in Pixelheim pays well for frost lilies.
quests.accepted: Four of them. They grow where the snow lies thick - and in the cave, where it never melts. I'll see they get to Vex.
quests.completed: Lovely. Vex will be insufferable about these. Keep a few for yourself - she can weave them into cloth, if you ask nicely.

quests.name: The Ice Hole
quests.brief: Someone has to fish for the caravan's supper.
quests.accepted: There's a hole cut in the lake ice, out past the middle. Stand at its edge, face the water and be patient. Icefin, three of them.
quests.completed: Supper! Real supper. Gunnar will stop complaining for a whole hour.

quests.name: A Coat for the Harbour
quests.brief: Brin's oilskin has more holes than coat. He wants a new one, made the Saltmere way.
quests.accepted: Sea glass and pelts, sewn tight at a forge. Make me an oilskin coat and I'll make it worth your while.
quests.completed: Now that's a coat. Here - a pearl from the jetty. Make something sharp with it.

quests.name: Iron for the Foreman
quests.brief: Garrick wants proof a smith can work Blackiron ore: a helm, forged from his seam.
quests.accepted: Three lumps of ore and a pelt for the lining. Forge me a Blackiron helm and the seam's yours to work.
quests.completed: Heavy, true, and it fits my thick head. Take this - we found it in the seam.

quests.name: A Hood Against the Pass
quests.brief: Linnea's brother crosses the pass at night. She wants him in Frostweave.
quests.accepted: Yeti fur and a frost lily, woven at a cauldron. A Frostweave hood, for my brother. Please.
quests.completed: He'll come home with his ears. Thank you. Take a lily - they only bloom up here.

steps.text: Help Maren dig through what's left of her house
steps.hint: Maren wants a hand with what's left of her house, along Upper Street from the shrine. She won't ask. Go anyway.
steps.elderHint: My house is along Upper Street, or what's left of it. Bring your back, courier. There's a hearthstone to lift.

steps.text: Ask Sela the innkeeper for work
steps.hint: Sela keeps the inn - or a tent on the square, if that's all there is. She always has a job going.

steps.text: Flatten three slimes in the fields east of town, then see Sela
steps.hint: Slimes nest in the fields east of the town gate. Three of them, and Sela pays.

steps.text: Put a roof back on Sela's inn
steps.hint: The board on the square lists what Pixelheim needs to rise again. Sela's inn first: a roof, real beds, and the homes around it.

steps.text: Brew a first potion at Vex's cauldron
steps.hint: Vex will show you the cauldron - at her stall on the square, or behind the BREWS door once it stands again. Potions you brew cost you a herb, not a fortune.

steps.text: Ask Maren about the barred mountain gate
steps.hint: The mountain's gate has been barred since the fire. Maren knows why, and what opens it - ask her.
steps.elderHint: The gate's been barred since the fire. Sit a moment, courier - I'll tell you why, and what opens it.

steps.text: Deliver Maren's letter to Old Wenna in Saltmere
steps.hint: Take the cliff road to Saltmere with Maren's first letter: south past the marsh, then down the cliffs. Old Wenna is Tam's sister.
steps.elderHint: Wenna first. Tam's sister, down in Saltmere: the cliff road, south past the marsh. ...Don't tell her I'm sorry. The letter says it.

steps.text: Bring Tam's ladle up from the wreck in the sea cave
steps.hint: The sea cave runs three floors down under Saltmere's headland. The boat that carried Tam's things home went down there, and something at the bottom kept them.
steps.elderHint: Tam's ladle. He'd want it back in a kitchen, not under the sea. Wenna will tell you where the boat went down.

steps.text: Cross the river and deliver Maren's letter to Old Pell at Blackiron
steps.hint: Over the river bridge north of town, then west along the Ash Fields road to the miners' camp. Old Pell guided the five down the shafts, once.
steps.elderHint: Pell next. A boy with a canary, when we came through Blackiron. Over the bridge and west. I owe him an apology. And a cage.

steps.text: Fetch the last ingot from the Black Seam
steps.hint: The Blackiron shafts run three floors down under the valley. At the bottom, in the Black Seam, something sits on the ingot the five stamped and forgot.
steps.elderHint: The last ingot. We stamped our five marks on it and left it in the seam for luck. Luck's run out, by the sound of it.

steps.text: Bring a settler home to Pixelheim
steps.hint: Iva the healer waits in the Mirefen, and Wren hunts the fields east of town. Help one of them, and they'll come and live here.

steps.text: Fund the street lamps at the board on the square
steps.hint: The board on the square lists what Pixelheim needs next. Lamps first: some coin and three marsh reeds.

steps.text: Take Maren's letter to Captain Hale at Greyhold
steps.hint: Greyhold stands off the east edge of the Ash Fields. The captain isn't receiving visitors: Sergeant Ulla keeps his camp by the road.
steps.elderHint: Hale kept Greyhold when we climbed, and Oskar was his. East, over the Ash Fields. If he can't take it, someone of his will.

steps.text: Read Hale's order book in his hall
steps.hint: Captain Hale's hall is behind the keep's door at Greyhold. Ulla says his order book is still on his table.

steps.text: Read Maren's letter to the Hollow Captain
steps.hint: Down the stair in Captain Hale's hall: the cellars run three floors down to the Captain's Hall, where the Hollow Captain still guards Oskar's shield.

steps.text: Deliver Maren's letter to Aske at Liane's observatory
steps.hint: The Frostgate road climbs north out of the Ash Fields to Liane's observatory, at the head of the pass. Aske has kept her door for fifty years, because she asked him to.
steps.elderHint: Aske last. He's kept Liane's door shut fifty years because she asked him to. North, up the Frostgate road. Tell him he can stop.

steps.text: Read Liane's sums in her room
steps.hint: Aske has opened Liane's door at the head of the Frostgate pass. Her sums are still on the desk in her room.
steps.elderHint: Liane did the sums for all five of us. If she left any behind, read them. She was always right, and it was always annoying.

steps.text: Bring Liane's lantern up from the glass hall
steps.hint: The stair in Liane's floor goes down into the old ice cave, three floors deep. At the bottom, in the glass hall, something white has curled up on her lantern.
steps.elderHint: Her lantern. She lit it the night before we climbed, so we'd find our way home. Bring it home, courier. One of us should.

steps.text: Bring the four keepsakes home to Maren
steps.hint: Maren waits for all four keepsakes: Tam's ladle, the last ingot, Oskar's shield and Liane's lantern. She'll open the gate with the last of them: her promise.
steps.elderHint: Bring them to me, all four, and I'll open the gate with the last of them: my promise.

chapters.title: The Fifth Letter
chapters.about: To be replaced (PIX-253 step 8): today's climb of the Ashen Mountain stands in until the mountain road, Morvax's forge and the fifth letter are built.

steps.text: Clear the Mossy Cellar, the mountain's first floor
steps.hint: The gate's open. The Ashen Mountain stands north of town, past the bridge; its first floor is the Mossy Cellar.

steps.text: Clear the Barrow Crypt (floor 3)
steps.hint: Below the woods lies the Barrow Crypt. The dead there don't stay down without help.

steps.text: Ask Maren about the graves in the crypt
steps.hint: Three names on a grave in the crypt, and a fourth chiselled away. Maren knew them, I think.
steps.elderHint: You found their names in the crypt. Ask, then. I owe you that much.

steps.text: Clear the Ruined Watchtower (floor 5)
steps.hint: Orcs hold the old watchtower now. Floor five. Bring potions.

steps.text: Clear the Sunken Forge (floor 7)
steps.hint: The golems of the Sunken Forge still work the bellows for no one. Floor seven.

steps.text: Clear the Stormcrag Aerie (floor 9)
steps.hint: Wyverns nest in the Stormcrag Aerie, one floor below the dragon. Mind the sky.

chapters.title: The Night of Bells
chapters.about: To be replaced (PIX-253 step 9): Fafnyr on the Ashen Throne stands in until the Night of Bells is played on the square.

steps.text: Slay Fafnyr on the Ashen Throne (floor 10)
steps.hint: Fafnyr is back on his hoard at the top of the mountain, and awake. Ten floors up. End it.

steps.text: Set Fafnyr's scale in a fountain on the square
steps.hint: Fafnyr's scale belongs on the square, where everyone can see it. The board will tell you what else the fountain takes.

chapters.title: Coming Home
chapters.about: To be replaced (PIX-253 step 10): the stair below the hoard and Morvax's throne stand in until the homecoming and his choice.

steps.text: Tell Maren what Fafnyr said about the voice below
steps.hint: Fafnyr spoke of a voice below. Maren will want to hear it - and she owes you a story.
steps.elderHint: Fafnyr spoke to you before he fell. Tell me what he said - and I'll tell you what I owe you.

steps.text: Take the stair below the hoard: clear the Sunless Stair (floor 11)
steps.hint: You beat the dragon. Then you've seen the stair behind its hoard. That's where the whispers come from.

steps.text: Clear the Vaulted Hoard (floor 13)
steps.hint: Deeper still, a vault the dead keep for their master. Mind the chests that bite.

steps.text: Cast down Morvax on the Throne of the Deathless (floor 15)
steps.hint: Morvax was one of us once, a hero of Pixelheim. Whatever he is now, it ends at the bottom.

mainQuest.done: Pixelheim is safe. The mountain is quiet, and the tavern isn't.

prologue.arrival: The letter was for Elder Maren of Pixelheim. You could see the fire from the last hill.
prologue.pouch: The slime was carrying a traveller's pouch: a health potion. {key:inventory} opens your pack.

steps.text: Drive off what's feeding at the road ({key:attack} to strike)
Get into Pixelheim: the gate is just south
Help whoever is calling on Upper Street ({key:interact} to help)
Find Sela's tent on the square
Bring the letter to Elder Maren at the shrine
Ash hounds come out of the fire: roll through a lunge ({key:dodge} to roll)
Wear the cap Sela gave you ({key:inventory} opens your pack)
Carry water from the well to the burning homes ({fires})
Embers swarm the square: drive them off ({key:skill_1} for your skill)
steps.textHeal: Embers swarm the square: strike them down ({key:attack}) - {key:skill_1} mends you between blows

dawn.line: Dawn came grey over the ashes. One by one the fires gave up, and the survivors gathered on the square.
"The Crown can no longer defend the Ashenreach." That's the whole of the Chancellor's letter.
Then we rebuild. With what, I couldn't tell you.
You carried bad news a long way, and you didn't run from the fire. Stay a while.
Fafnyr will come back for what's left of us. Unless someone climbs.
The Chancellor's courier should have ridden south by noon. You stayed.

hounds.name: Ash Hound
hounds.cleared: The hounds crumble into cinders. Someone is calling from Upper Street.

embers.name: Ember
embers.cleared: The last ember gutters out on the stones. Maren is waiting at the shrine.

cap.given: Sela binds your cuts and presses a leather cap into your hands. "It's not much. Wear it."

fires.well: You fill a bucket at the well.
fires.empty: Your hands are empty: the well is on the green, below the square.
fires.done: The last of the fires you can reach is out. The square is glowing - embers, blown off the roofs.

relics.barred: The mountain's gate is barred with old iron and older wards. Nothing passes. Maren will know what opens it.

letters.about: PIX-253 step 1: Maren's five letters, found in a tin under her hearthstone the morning after the Night of Ash. Four go out across the Reach as quests of the deliverTo kind, in the story's order; the fifth, to Morvax, stays with her for chapter 6. `dig` is where she stands while the tin waits and her house is ash; `news` is what a villager says once the letters are out (Bram's crew clears the cliff road), until Wenna has hers; `room` is Sela's word the first night the courier pays for a bed. A letter pays its postage on delivery (the recipient paid the post, then) and no XP: the XP curve is retuned with the story's last step. Step 2, the satchel: each letter's `addressed` names its row in the journal; `letter` is Maren's own words, read in the journal's Letters tab once it's delivered (a courier never reads the post); `answered` is its row's line once it's answered, and `gist` the answer's heart, under the list. `fifth` is the letter Maren keeps. A letter's `reading` (PIX-255, chapters 4 and 5) is an answer that waits where it was written: Captain Hale's order book on his table, Liane's sums on her desk (`rect`, the cells E reads it from), shut until the letter is delivered, its `lines` read once into the story ledger (`sceneId`, a main quest step of the seen kind), `again` after.

fifth.note: Maren keeps this one. It has no address.

tin: You came. Good. Mind that beam, it's still warm. My hearthstone's under there somewhere, and I'm too old to lift it alone.
(You lift the hearthstone together. Under it is a tin box, and in the tin five letters, addressed in a young woman's hand. The fifth says only "Morvax".)
Leave those. They were never meant to be sent.
("Letters that aren't delivered are just paper," you say.)
...Four of them, then. The fifth has no address.
late: (Maren turns a tin box over in her hands, black with soot.) I dug this out of my hearth. Five letters I wrote fifty years ago, and never sent.
You carry letters, courier. Take the ones that can still be delivered. The fifth has no address.
letters.taken: Four letters in your satchel: for Old Wenna in Saltmere, Old Pell at Blackiron, Captain Hale at Greyhold and Aske on the Frostgate. Maren keeps the fifth.
letters.takenSome: In your satchel: %s. Maren keeps the fifth.
letters.answered: Maren's letters were answered long ago: you brought their keepsakes home. She keeps the fifth.
letters.road: Bram's crew is out clearing the cliff road to Saltmere.

news.villager_bram: Cliff road to Saltmere's clear, courier. Took the whole crew all morning. I lifted one rock. Supervised the rest.

letters.room: Sela takes your coin. "You're paying now, you know. Heroes pay double. ...Fine. Half."

deeds.name: Ten Below
deeds.line: Clear depth 10 of the Deep Hunt.

deeds.name: Thirty Below
deeds.line: Clear depth 30 of the Deep Hunt.

deeds.name: Every Bounty Paid
deeds.line: Slay every named monster, the Reach's and the deep's.

deeds.name: Slayer of All Kinds
deeds.line: Reach Slayer III against every family.

deeds.name: Dressed for It
deeds.line: Wear a whole armour set at once.

deeds.name: Seen Them All
deeds.line: Meet every kind in the bestiary.
